allocations.title: Connect a wallet to see your allocations
allocations.description: Your retrievable ETH, Anchor Distributions, and attached NFTs and tokens appear here once you connect.

anchors.title: Connect a wallet to manage your anchors
anchors.description: Your anchored NFTs, the NFTs you can anchor, and your Anchor Distributions appear here once you connect.

nfts.title: Connect a wallet to see your NFTs
nfts.description: The Cosmic Signature NFTs in your wallet appear here once you connect, and you can send them to another address.

statistics.title: Connect a wallet to see your statistics
statistics.description: Your gestures, allocations and anchors across every Performance Cycle appear here once you connect.

history.title: Connect a wallet to see your allocation history
history.description: Every allocation made to your wallet, in every Performance Cycle, appears here once you connect.

transferCst.title: Connect a wallet to send CST
transferCst.description: Once you connect, your CST balance appears here with a form to send it and a link to your transfer history.
